target_customer: Internal audit and SOX compliance teams at public companies
problem: SOX control testing is repetitive, document heavy manual work done in spreadsheets, with talent shortages and rising compliance cost.
business_model: B2B SaaS (web app plus Excel add-in)
product_category: AI agents for SOX testing and internal audit

founders.name: Kieran Taylor
founders.background_notes: Listed as CEO in a podcast interview; YC page lists him as Founder.

founders.name: Aahel Iyer
founders.background_notes: Led UX teams; sources conflict on which founder holds this bio.

competitors.name: AuditBoard
competitors.what: Audit and SOX management platform adding AI, analytics and annotation features
competitors.traction_then: Established market leader in audit and GRC software

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents had to ingest unstructured evidence, run tie-outs and produce audit grade workpapers with traceability; feasible with LLMs in 2024 but accuracy and trust requirements were high.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integration with Excel and audit evidence offers some stickiness, but incumbents were adding AI and the models were commodity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AuditBoard, rebranded as Optro, acquired Midship in May 2026 to fold agentic control testing into its Controls Management product.

market_need_then: Public companies must test internal controls annually under Sarbanes-Oxley and the work was manual; by 2024 incumbents were launching AI features, signaling demand.

branding.domain_note: Used midship.ai; it now redirects to optro.ai after the acquisition.

rebrands.why: Acquired and merged into Optro's platform.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself; coverage focused on product and funding.

outcome_analysis: Midship was a three person Summer 2024 team applying AI agents to SOX testing, a regulated and recurring workflow with budget. It reported use at large public companies, raised a 4.15 million dollar seed led by Costanoa in January 2026, and four months later was acquired by Optro, the market leader formerly called AuditBoard, with founders joining the product team. Terms were undisclosed.
notes: Seed confirmed by two outlets (CPA Practice Advisor, Pulse 2.0) that likely reprint one press release. Acquisition date reported variously as May 6 to May 13, 2026. The website fetch only returned a redirect to optro.ai, which was not fetched. Fieldguide's agent launches are 2026 and excluded from competition as of founding. Founder bios conflict between sources.
